# Kamigen

> Kamigen is a solarpunk comic and game world based around Visayan culture, independently developed by Open Studios.

## Main sections

- [Homepage](https://kamigen.com/): Introduction and latest release
- [Comics](https://kamigen.com/comics.html): Issues and pages in reading order
- [World guide](https://kamigen.com/wiki.html): Characters, locations, lore and production material
- [Blog](https://kamigen.com/blog.html): Project news and production updates
- [Game demo](https://kamigen.com/game.html): Interactive WebGL prototype

## Machine-readable access

- [XML sitemap](https://kamigen.com/sitemap.xml)
- Comic reader pages include a text transcript below each image.
- Navigation and content use semantic HTML and descriptive links.
